The strongest reflection loss of -53.69 dB for BaFe₁₂O₁₉ occurs at 14.75 GHz for complete pyramidal face nanocrystals.
CNWCFs at 1 mm thickness show reflectivity less than -4 dB over 11.8-18 GHz and less than -10 dB over 13.5-16 GHz.

After annealing at 400°C for 4 hours, electroless (Ni-P)/BaNi₀.₄Ti₀.₄Fe₁₁.₂O₁₉ nanocomposite powder RL improves to -35.90 dB with bandwidth of 4.00 GHz.
MnFe₂O₄-TiO₂ nanocomposites show enhanced imaginary parts of permeability due to eddy loss of semiconductor TiO₂ nanoparticles.
